meta.title: Dev architecture: runtime, startup and deployment (after Terraform review)

views.label: Request path
views.note: Follow HTTP ingress, permitted security-group hops, then private SQL over TLS.

views.label: Startup and logs
views.note: Execution role pulls images, injects DB_PASSWORD and delivers awslogs through public endpoints via IGW.

views.label: Deploy and state
views.note: Bootstrap owns the bucket; dev owns its resources and separate S3 state key. Push the image before full apply.

cards.title: Network placement and security
items: VPC 10.0.0.0/16. Public /24 subnets: .1 and .2; private DB /24 subnets: .11 and .12, across two pinned AZs (var.azs).
Public route: 0.0.0.0/0 to IGW. DB subnets: VPC-local routes only. The VPC default SG is locked down (no rules), so nothing can join it by accident.
One task is placed in either public subnet; API SG admits allowed_cidr on 8080. Default allowed_cidr is 0.0.0.0/0.

cards.title: Execution role and startup dependencies
items: Fargate uses the execution role for ECR image pulls, Secrets Manager GetSecretValue and CloudWatch Logs. No application task role is configured.
Image pulls, secret reads and log delivery use public AWS endpoints via task public IPs and IGW. No NAT gateway or VPC endpoints.
DB_PASSWORD is injected at launch; rotate then replace tasks. The startup SQL/schema gate must pass before the API listens. Runtime node includes ECS-managed setup.

cards.title: Deployment and state ownership
items: Bootstrap uses local state and creates the protected S3 state bucket; old state versions expire after 90 days. Dev writes lesson10-11/dev/terraform.tfstate with use_lockfile=true.
Create ECR first; build/push ARM64 image to lesson10-11-api; apply the environment root. Circuit breaker enables rollback.
ECS container probe uses /health (process only); operator checks /ready (DB ping). Discover the new public IP after replacement.
Plan-time validation rejects a non-/16 or IPv6 VPC, IPv6 allowed_cidr, invalid Fargate cpu/memory pairs, bad ports and over-long names.

cards.title: Data lifecycle and evidence
items: DB backups: disabled; deletion protection false; final snapshot skipped. ECR force_delete=true.
RDS takes automatic minor upgrades and copies tags to snapshots.
HTTP only; no application authentication. RDS is one Single-AZ instance, not two database replicas.
Configured defaults from the working tree after the 2026-10-22 Terraform review, not live AWS inventory; the stack is destroyed.
